setup: Tangent is the ratio opposite over adjacent, and it can be reached two ways from what is given.

steps.say: From the right triangle: the side opposite the angle in question is [[opp]] and the one next to it is [[adj]], so tangent is [[opp]]/[[adj]].

From sine and cosine instead: tangent is $\sin(\theta)$ divided by $\cos(\theta)$, which is $([[sin_num]]/[[sin_den]]) \div ([[cos_num]]/[[cos_den]])$. Dividing by a fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal, so the two fractions turn into one over the other.
